_what: The controls screen arrangement draws that a show rule can hide (subject `control`, parts/ui/show/show-rules show-of.ts controlShown): its chrome zones (every zone is `arrangement.<zone>`, read-data/region-chrome.ts zoneControl) and an empty pane's sections (`arrangement.empty.<part>`, show/EmptyContainer.tsx shows). A rule on `arrangement.header` hides the pane's whole tab bar, the sidebar frame it is (show/ContainerHeader.tsx); a rule on `arrangement.empty` an empty pane's every section; a rule on `arrangement.zoom` every way to zoom the panes (the arrangement then draws at its normal size, and a pinch or ctrl/⌘ with the wheel over it does nothing, the page's own zoom included).
